title: The Illusion of Safety: Multi-Tier Verification of AI vs. Human C++ Code
abstract: arXiv:2607.00107v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for systems programming, their ability to generate secure C++ code remains a critical concern. Yet most security evaluations of AI-generated code rely on static analysis alone, which flags warnings without confirming runtime violations or reasoning about untested paths. This study investigates whether C++ code generated by open-weight LLMs is measurably less safe than human-written code, and whether common verification tools agree on the risk. We introduce VULBENCH-CPP, a benchmark of 8,918 C++ programs from three open-weight LLMs (Gemma 3 27B IT, LLaMA 3.3 70B Instruct, Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B Instruct) and human authors across 851 competitive-programming tasks. Each program is annotated by four verification tiers: functional testing, static analysis (cppcheck, clang-tidy), dynamic analysis (ASan/UBSan), and bounded model checking (ESBMC). translated_title: 安全的假象：AI与人类C++代码的多层级验证
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署用于系统编程，其生成安全C++代码的能力仍然是一个关键问题。然而，大多数针对AI生成代码的安全评估仅依赖静态分析，而静态分析只会标记警告，既无法确认运行时违规，也无法对未经测试的代码路径进行推理。本研究探讨开放权重LLM生成的C++代码在可测量程度上是否比人类编写的代码更不安全，以及常用的验证工具是否对风险有一致的判断。我们提出了VULBENCH-CPP，这是一个包含8,918个C++程序的基准数据集，这些程序由三个开放权重LLM（Gemma 3 27B IT、LLaMA 3.3 70B Instruct、Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B Instruct）与人类作者在851个竞赛编程任务上生成。每个程序均通过四个验证层级进行标注：功能测试、静态分析（cppcheck、clang-tidy）、动态分析（ASan/UBSan）以及有界模型检验（ESBMC）。在静态分析下，两者看起来同等……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了包含8,918个C++程序的VULBENCH-CPP基准，通过功能测试、静态分析、动态分析和有界模型检验四个层级系统对比AI与人类编写的代码，揭示了仅依赖静态分析会带来“安全的假象”。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VULBENCH-CPP, a benchmark of 8,918 C++ programs comparing AI-generated and human-written code across four verification tiers (functional testing, static analysis, dynamic analysis, and bounded model checking), revealing that static analysis alone creates an illusion of safety.
